name: qualify-async-cpu-bound-go
note: Expected: good and good-pool pass (good-pool's measures show its worker goroutines); parallel-alloc (orders allocated in goroutines under a mutex, results kept by sequence) and parallel-waves (carts printed by goroutines as they finish) fail hidden_cases_correct and deterministic; map-order (backorders printed by ranging over a map, no goroutines) fails hidden_cases_correct and deterministic; wrong (same-second orders in file order) fails hidden_cases_correct only; noop fails hidden_cases_correct only (every waves run is the same usage error, so deterministic holds, and stock and check are the fixture's). Needs bubblewrap and the host's Go (TRIAL_GOROOT overrides it); command arms need no readable entries, agent arms need the Go toolchain readable when it is under the home.
